admission.definition: Executor decision that a proposal becomes a canonical fact through the temporal helpers. Distinct from receipt outcome applied and from blueprint outcomes such as review_required or held.

alias.definition: A typed alternate name (synonym, acronym, former_name, handle, ticker, slug, misspelling, translation, model_alias). Unique per (entity, normalized alias, alias_kind), not globally unique across entities.

artifact.definition: Content-addressed stored object (sha256, bucket_class, storage_bucket, object_path) typed by artifact_type. Lineage edges record derived_from, supersedes, corrects, produced_by, consumed_by.

assurance.definition: How strongly a knowledge record or vector item is backed. knowledge.assurance_level is the vocabulary; retrieval filters accept a minimum assurance rank.

belief.definition: accepted, disputed, or unknown on a segment or occurrence. disputed does not replace an accepted current segment; the executor plans review_required.

canonical-entity.definition: One row in corpus.entity. kind picks the typed child table. lifecycle is active, merged, or retired. Typed attributes live in corpus.<kind>, not on the identity row.

claim.definition: An atomic statement with claim_type, status, and created_by_receipt_id. Facts may cite a claim as primary_claim_id. Subjects are attached via claim_subject roles subject, object, or context.

cost-class.definition: Catalog hint for statement_timeout and EXPLAIN gates. cheap and medium default to 15s; heavy is 60s and must not sequential-scan large relations.

domain.definition: A curated map of 5–15 relations that belong together (identity, temporal-facts, evidence, …). Default domain for a schema is schema_domains; a relation overlay may override it.

entity-kind.definition: taxonomy.entity_kind.code. Points at canonical_schema/canonical_table. corpus.entity.kind is a foreign key; unknown kinds cannot be inserted.

evidence-packet.definition: A retrieval-assembled bundle of members (chunks, records, locators, timecodes) for one question. Read with api.evidence_packet.

extent.definition: Source text for a date with precision (instant, day, month, quarter, year, relative, unknown) and optional earliest/latest bounds. Required when temporal_basis is explicit or carry_forward.

fingerprint.definition: Digest of schema structure plus vocabularies, or of workspace plus enrichment. Artifacts also carry content sha256. Ingestion intents cite workspaceFingerprint; mismatch is WORKSPACE_STALE.

hybrid-search.definition: api.hybrid_knowledge_search_1536 fuses exact, full-text, trigram, and ANN channels with reciprocal rank fusion. Requires a published vector-space version and a query embedding computed by the executor.

idempotency-key.definition: Unique per tenant on operation_intent and knowledge_batch. A second submit of the same bytes returns the existing receipt as duplicate_of.

identifier.definition: A schemed external identifier. scheme is a closed check-constraint vocabulary. Unique per tenant on (scheme, value), so one identifier names at most one entity.

intent.definition: A durable proposed operation. knowledge-read-intent.v1 and knowledge-ingestion-intent.v1 are the workspace contracts; the ledger row is orchestration.operation_intent with an idempotency_key.

knowledge-batch.definition: One committed admission transaction. commit_batch writes a knowledge_batch row with a receipt, idempotency key, and input digest, then advances the tenant head by one.

knowledge-head.definition: Per-tenant monotonic sequence of sealed knowledge batches. Every snapshot and ingestion intent cites it; begin_batch fails rebase_required when the expected head does not match.

knowledge-time.definition: When a fact was admitted or closed. Stamped from the open batch. Current rows have k_to null; closed rows keep history.

locator.definition: A precise selection inside a capture (text_quote, table, media_timecode, …) with selected_content_sha256. Support rows require a locator.

mission.definition: orchestration.mission is the durable work envelope. Intents and artifacts may record mission_id. Mission Control admission is out of band; this workspace only stores the id when supplied.

named-query.definition: An entry in the knowledge-query-catalog. Agents pass a name and params; they never send SQL. Build validation executes each example under the catalog role.

projection.definition: A derived retrieval object (search_projection, vector_item) built from documents, records, or entities. Projection rebuilding is a governed runtime operation, not an agent write.

publication.definition: A published vector-space version that hybrid search is allowed to read. Unpublished or inactive versions raise insufficient_privilege.

rebase-required.definition: Transaction failure (SQLSTATE 40001) from begin_batch when expected head does not match the locked knowledge_head. Not a per-proposal outcome.

receipt.definition: Immutable orchestration.operation_receipt for one intent. Outcome is applied, rejected, noop, or partial. Facts and entities require a receipt id before they can be written.

relationship-kind.definition: taxonomy.relationship_kind.code with from_kinds, to_kinds, temporal flag, and property_schema. Trigger corpus.check_relationship_kinds rejects illegal endpoints.

rls.definition: Enabled on tenant tables. Typical policy km_tenant_access uses tenant_id = util.current_tenant_id(). Grants without a matching tenant context return no rows or fail closed.

role.definition: NOLOGIN Postgres roles. app_reader sees api views and RPCs. pipeline_agent selects bounded schemas. executor_service alone executes temporal helpers and writes corpus facts.

scope-key.definition: Distinguishes parallel series on the same subject and stream kind (region, unit, episode). Default is the empty string. Part of the stream unique key; the database enforces no naming convention, so a correction must reuse the existing series key.

segment.definition: One assertion of a fact on a stream. Carries a world interval valid_during and a knowledge interval [k_from, k_to). Current means k_to is null.

staging-candidate.definition: An unresolved proposed identity. Not a staging copy of a fact. Resolution decisions are create, match, reject, or defer; vetting decisions are admit, reject, or defer.

stream.definition: The identity of a fact series, unique on (kind, subject entity or relationship, scope_key). Segments stack on a stream; overlapping current segments are forbidden.

stream-kind.definition: temporal.stream_kind.code with subject_mode, subject_kinds, status_values, unit_values, requires_amount, and payload_schema. commit_batch validates slot rules.

support.definition: A k-stamped link from a claim and locator to a segment or event occurrence. Written only through temporal.admit_support inside an open batch.

task.definition: A question family with navigation, a read or ingestion operation, expected shape, and pitfalls. The shortest path from a natural-language question to a valid catalog query or intent.

temporal-basis.definition: Why the world interval is believed. explicit and carry_forward require an extent; observation_bounded is “true at capture time”; unresolved is an admitted gap.

tenant.definition: Isolation key read from GUC app.tenant_id by util.current_tenant_id(). Missing context fails closed. RLS policies compare tenant_id to that function.

two-clocks.definition: World time and knowledge time together. entity.at(entity, T, K) answers what was true at T as we knew it at K.

unit-value.definition: Allowed unit on an amount-bearing stream, listed in stream_kind.unit_values. For model_offering_price a new series defaults its scope_key to the unit so parallel price series do not collide; an existing series keeps whatever scope_key it has.

vector-space.definition: A named retrieval space (engineering_claims, entity_profiles, …) with versions and publications. Agents read only published versions; unpublished embeddings are invisible to hybrid search.

verification-run.definition: An evidence.verification_run that must be sealed before cited claims may be materialized. Ingestion refuses EVIDENCE_NOT_ELIGIBLE for unsealed or failing verdicts.

vocabulary.definition: Allowlisted code tables such as taxonomy.entity_kind, taxonomy.relationship_kind, temporal.stream_kind, and identifier schemes. Slot rules and endpoint kinds are enforced at write time.

workspace.definition: Generated projection of schema-ir.v1 into Markdown layers, search indexes, and the named-query catalog. Agents search then read a domain or task page; they never read schema-ir.json whole.

world-time.definition: When the world was like this. Stored as a tstzrange bounded below with [) bounds. Distinct from when we came to know it.
